note: GET /orgs/:id/usage, session-authed, for an active member of the org. seatLimit is null where no billing service is attached and no seat gate runs; vmLimit is never null, because orgs.vm_limit has always had a value. platformCompute is never null: it is the stored flag, and 0 on every deployment that has no billing service.

subscribed.note: A plan that includes compute. The organization runs on the deployment credential without one of its own, and an admin reads that here rather than guessing at why a create was allowed.
